question: How long does bird netting installation typically take in Chennai?
answer:
The installation timeline for bird netting from GCM Netting Solutions in Chennai depends on a few factors, including the size of the area to be covered and the complexity of the installation. However, we generally aim to complete most residential bird netting installations within 2 to 4 hours. For larger commercial properties or more complex installations, it may take a full day or, in rare cases, slightly longer. We always strive to minimize disruption to your daily routine.

At GCM Netting Solutions, we use high-quality HDPE (High-Density Polyethylene) material that is UV stabilized to withstand the harsh Chennai climate, ensuring long-lasting protection against birds. All our installations are performed by experienced professionals who are trained to install the netting securely and efficiently. We also offer a warranty of 3 to 5 years on our bird netting installations, giving you peace of mind.
